module: Editor window "IES Cookie Importer (WIP)" (Window > Experimental menu). It reads an IES photometric file, displays its metadata (header, photometric type, units, peak direction), a preview, and generates a light "cookie" image (PNG named by default <file>.color.png, with metadata) via editor/api/iesImporter. Useful to a modder who wants to create headlight projection textures from IES data.
notes: Default IES path: '/art/special/ies/'. The output path is inferred by iesCookie.inferCookiePathFromIES, otherwise <path without .ies>.color.png; it is recomputed on each validation and the folder is created if needed.

Parameters (default, bounds applied before generation): resolution 2^9 = 512 (exponent 5 to 12, i.e. 32 to 4096), auto angle true / 35 degrees manual (0.001 to 179), projection perspective or linear, rotation 0 (-360 to 360), auto center false / theta 0 (0 to 180) / phi 0 (0 to 360), edgeFeather 0 (0 to 1), percentile 100 (0.001 to 100), gamma 1 (0.1 to 4), scale 1 (0 to 4), invert false.
The manual angle and center are ignored when autoAngle / autoCenter is enabled (the auto center comes from the peak direction of the IES file).
Generation runs in a jobsystem job; if it is unavailable, it runs synchronously (generateCookieSync). A second generation while another is running is refused.
The drawing functions and helpers are local (not exported); only the extension lifecycle is exposed. The file picker uses editor_fileDialog.openFile (.ies filter).

onEditorGui.desc: Called every frame by the editor: initializes the defaults once, handles the possible end of the generation job, then draws the window (files/info table and preview, then settings).

onWindowMenuItem.desc: Shows the 'iesEditor' window (editor.showWindow); called by the menu entry.

onEditorInitialized.desc: Called at editor initialization: adds the menu entry in the 'Experimental' group, registers the window (980x700), initializes the defaults and logs 'Initialized'.
